notes: Allowance ledger: your prizes are already written as cash ($5.00 Cash), so the hub now reads the dollar amount out of the prize text. Winning a cash prize adds that money to an allowance balance kept SEPARATE from the stars, so the auto-reset never wipes what a kid is owed. Family Management gains an Allowance section: what's owed, lifetime earned and paid, Mark paid (full or partial), and a manual Add - every payout logged with the date and who paid it. The prize box tells you what it read as you type, so a non-cash prize like Movie night never quietly creates a debt. Also: the retired Alarmo integration is gone from the Security card, the Activity timeline and the health check, and Away mode no longer arms anything - it just sets the thermostat back and pauses chores and the internet gate.
